object.attr: as implemented: added in 0.3.0. A merged cell that spans a header row and a row below can't be repeated without the lower row (CF-P43). Header row, merged cell and span are EDIT's terms.
object.description: The exported PDF shall repeat a table's leading header rows at the top of each page the table continues onto, unless a merged cell spans a header row and a row below the header rows.
